description_en: Queries the symbol files uploaded by RUM users and supports filtering by platform, file type, version, and keywords
description_zh: 查询 RUM 用户上传的符号文件，支持按平台、文件类型、版本和关键词筛选
name: GetRumSymbolFiles

parameters.help_en: The filter for the symbol file type. Valid values: map, dsym, txt, so, sym, pdb, and json. This parameter is used for query filtering and differs from the fileKind dimension in the upload API GetRumSymbolFileParams: uploading dsym (.dSYM.zip) corresponds to artifactType=dsym; standard symbol-zip (.zip) is not currently supported for filtering by artifactType
parameters.help_zh: 符号文件类型过滤。取值：map、dsym、txt、so、sym、pdb、json。该参数用于查询过滤，与上传接口 GetRumSymbolFileParams 的 fileKind 取值维度不同：上传 dsym（.dSYM.zip）对应 artifactType=dsym；普通 symbol-zip（.zip）暂不支持通过 artifactType 过滤
parameters.name: artifact_type

parameters.help_en: The list of search keywords. You can specify up to 50 keywords to match file names, UUIDs, version numbers, and more
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词列表（最多 50 个，用于匹配文件名、UUID、版本号等）
parameters.name: keywords

parameters.help_en: The paging token. To query the next page, specify the nextToken value returned in the previous response. The example is for illustration purposes only and cannot be used for actual queries
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询令牌。查询下一页时，请填写上一次响应返回的 nextToken；示例仅用于说明，不能用于实际查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回数量，取值范围 1~100，默认 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The filter for the platform type. Valid values: web, miniapp, minigame, uniapp, android, ios, harmonyos, windows, macos, and linux
parameters.name: platform

parameters.help_en: The service ID of the RUM application. This parameter is required, cannot be an empty string, and must be used together with workspace to locate the application
parameters.help_zh: RUM 应用服务 ID。调用时必须提供，且不能为空白字符串，须与 workspace 一并用于定位应用
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en: The filter for the application version number
parameters.name: version

parameters.help_en: The name of the workspace to which the RUM application belongs. This parameter is required, cannot be an empty string, and must be used together with serviceId to locate the application
parameters.help_zh: RUM 应用所属的工作空间名称。调用时必须提供，且不能为空白字符串，须与 serviceId 一并用于定位应用
parameters.name: workspace

artifactPath.description_en: The object path of the symbol file

artifactType.description_en: The type of the symbol file

fileName.description_en: The name of the symbol file

matchedKeywords.description_en: The list of matched search keywords
matchedKeywords.description_zh: 命中的搜索关键词列表

items.description_en: The keyword from the request that matches the object path, file name, UUID, or version number of the file
items.description_zh: 请求关键词中与该文件对象路径、文件名、UUID 或版本号匹配的关键词

matchedKeywords.title_en: 命中的搜索关键词列表
matchedKeywords.title_zh: 命中的搜索关键词列表

platform.description_en: The platform type to which the file belongs

size.description_en: The size of the file in bytes

source.description_en: The source of the symbol file. This query API returns only symbol files uploaded by users, which is fixed to user. The value system is reserved for internal system symbols of the platform
source.description_zh: 符号文件来源。当前查询接口仅返回用户上传的符号文件（固定为 user）；system 仅作为平台内部系统符号来源保留值
source.title_en: 符号文件来源。当前查询接口仅返回用户上传的符号文件（固定为 user）；system 仅作为平台内部系统符号来源保留值。
source.title_zh: 符号文件来源。当前查询接口仅返回用户上传的符号文件（固定为 user）；system 仅作为平台内部系统符号来源保留值。

updateTime.description_en: The timestamp of the last time the file was updated, in milliseconds
updateTime.description_zh: 文件最后更新时间戳（毫秒）
updateTime.title_en: 文件最后更新时间戳（毫秒）
updateTime.title_zh: 文件最后更新时间戳（毫秒）

uuid.description_en: The UUID or Debug ID of the symbol file
uuid.description_zh: 符号文件 UUID / Debug ID
uuid.title_en: 符号文件 UUID / Debug ID
uuid.title_zh: 符号文件 UUID / Debug ID

hasMore.description_en: Indicates whether more data is available

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. The example is for illustration purposes only and cannot be used for actual queries. To query the next page, use the actual value returned in the response
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页查询令牌。示例仅用于说明，不能用于实际查询；查询下一页时，请使用响应实际返回的值

pageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
